concept.title: AuditX Workflows Overview
concept.shortdesc: AuditX supports three primary workflow types that enable organizations to capture, verify, and document packing operations in real time. Each workflow is designed for specific operational requirements and can be customized to match your business processes.

section.title: Workflow Purpose and Benefits
section.p: Workflows are the core operational mechanism in AuditX. They define how your packing operations are recorded, verified, and linked to order data. Each workflow:

ul.li: Links visual evidence (video or images) directly to order IDs
Validates scanned items against original order specifications
Captures metadata (timestamps, barcodes, system names)
Provides audit trails and compliance documentation
Integrates with eCommerce platforms and external systems via webhooks

row.entry: Validate each scanned item matches order specifications
Capture still images at scan points
eCommerce order fulfillment with Shopify/WMS integration
Comprehensive process documentation and dispute resolution
Quick verification and lightweight storage requirement

section.title: 1. Order Verification Workflow
section.p: The Order Verification Workflow is designed for eCommerce fulfillment operations that require validation of scanned items against order data.

ul.li: What it does: Automatically validates each scanned barcode against the order specifications from Shopify or other eCommerce platforms
Records: Video of packing process linked to verification data
Best for: High-volume eCommerce operations requiring integration with order management systems
Key features: Barcode validation, order reconciliation, real-time discrepancy alerts
Learn more: See "Create an Order Verification Workflow"

section.title: 2. Video Recording Workflow
section.p: The Video Recording Workflow captures the entire packing process in full motion video format for comprehensive documentation.

ul.li: What it does: Records continuous video of packing operations and links the video file to the order or barcode ID
Records: Complete video file with metadata overlay (timestamps, barcodes, event IDs)
Best for: Organizations requiring detailed visual proof of packing quality and handling procedures
Key features: Configurable resolution (4K or 1080p), compression options, automatic event segmentation
Learn more: See "Create a Video Recording Workflow"

section.title: 3. Image Logging Workflow
section.p: The Image Logging Workflow captures high-resolution still images at predetermined intervals or scan points during packing.

ul.li: What it does: Takes snapshots at each barcode scan and links images to order IDs in near-real-time
Records: Sequential images with optional annotations and metadata
Best for: Operations needing quick verification with minimal storage requirements
Key features: Automatic image capture on scan, configurable capture delay, lightweight file format
Learn more: See "Create an Image Logging Workflow"

section.title: Common Workflow Features
section.p: All AuditX workflows share these core capabilities:

dlentry.dd: Define barcode field names, length ranges, and classification rules using regular expressions
Automatically overlay event ID, barcode, timestamp, and system name on recordings
Show sub-event indicators (individual SKU scans) and weight data during video playback
Choose between Standard (broader compatibility) and Advanced (higher compression)
Send event data to Shopify, WMS systems, or custom external applications
Choose to stop recording or overwrite older events when storage quota is reached

section.title: Workflow Configuration Process
section.p: Creating any workflow in AuditX follows a consistent process:

ol.li: Basic Information: Name the workflow and assign it to a site
Workflow Type: Select Order Verification, Video Recording, or Image Logging
Barcode Configuration: Define barcode parameters and classification rules
Integration Setup: Configure Shopify or external API connections (if applicable)
Event Configuration: Choose annotation options and overlay settings
Camera/Media Settings: Set recording duration and resolution
Credit Management: Define behavior when storage quota is exhausted
Review and Save: Verify all settings and activate the workflow

section.title: Workflow Selection Guide
section.p: Use this table to determine which workflow best fits your operational needs:

strow.stentry: Provides direct integration and real-time validation
Full video documentation supports all investigation needs
Still images reduce storage and processing requirements

section.title: Event URL Reports
section.p: Before creating any workflow, you should enable the Event URL Report feature in Settings. This generates shareable URLs for each event recording, enabling stakeholders to access videos or images without logging into AuditX directly.

ul.li: Navigate to Settings and enable Event URL Report
Validate with OTP when prompted
Event URLs are automatically generated when events are recorded
URLs can be shared with Shopify orders, sent via webhooks, or included in reports
